_help: Rules that mark plays as NOT personal listening. 'enabled' sets the site default (each rule can also be toggled in the site's Exclusions panel). Match on 'artists' (exact names), 'track_regex', 'album_regex', 'show_regex' (case-insensitive Python regex). Optional 'when' limits the rule to local weekdays (0=Mon..6=Sun) and a start/end time window. Re-run scripts/build_data.py after editing. A rule with "type": "overnight" ignores names and instead marks songs that played on their own after you stopped touching Spotify late at night, until your first touch the next morning (see params).

rules.label: Instrumental artists
rules.description: Artists whose music is mostly without singing: piano covers, classical, film scores, lo-fi and similar.

rules.label: Playing while asleep
rules.description: Songs that kept playing on their own after your last touch at night (no taps, skips or picks until the morning). Counts from 30 minutes after your last touch, between 11pm and 9am.

rules.label: Shoulders on repeat at night
rules.description: When Shoulders played more than 10 times in a row starting in the evening (6pm to 4am), plays after the 10th.

rules.label: Game-show and classroom game music
rules.description: Jeopardy, The Price Is Right, Wheel of Fortune, Family Feud, Millionaire, Kahoot! lobby music and similar.
rules.track_regex: jeopardy|price is right|wheel of fortune|family feud|who wants to be a millionaire|game show|kahoot

rules.label: Lo-fi/focus music during school hours
rules.description: Artists played 84–94% of the time Mon–Fri 7:30am–3:00pm (Chilled Pig, Lowfie, Edward Ong, Minnz Piano, Lofi Fruits, Wildlife Bill, Todd Baker, Second Breakfast).

rules.label: Kids, party & movement songs
rules.description: Baby Shark, Cupid Shuffle, Cha Cha Slide, Macarena, Hokey Pokey, VeggieTales, cartoon theme songs.
rules.track_regex: baby shark|cupid shuffle|cha cha slide|macarena|hokey|hairbrush song|magic school bus|my little pony|phineas and ferb|hot wheels

rules.label: Video-game themes
rules.description: Mario, Mario Kart and similar game music (mostly played during school hours).
rules.track_regex: super mario|mario kart|starman theme|coconut mall|rainbow road

rules.label: Sleep sounds & white noise
rules.description: White/brown noise and sleep-sound tracks and shows (≈126 hours).
